name: Campingplatz Huber See
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Huber See is set on the lakefront in Tyrol, surrounded by breathtaking mountain scenery. The unspoilt natural setting features lush forests and crystal-clear waters. Amenities include comfortable sanitary facilities, a children's playground, and a kiosk stocking essential supplies. The peaceful, family-friendly ambience makes it ideal for couples, families, and nature enthusiasts eager to hike, swim, and relax.
